answer: One concrete mechanism is a bonded-stake gate: every agent must lock collateral in a shared vault and register a hardware attestation to earn an identity. A sybil operator running many clones must fund a separate vault and distinct hardware for each account, so every fake identity carries a real, slashable cost. Reputation accrues to the bonded identity, and abuse slashes the stake, so shallow clones cannot outvote a genuine agent. Physical anchoring adds cost: two relays cannot report from the same jetty mooring or grassy knoll, since attestation binds one location to one key.
